mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the interior area of the rectangle. Right image: The shaded points constitute the solution region on one side of the linear boundary.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and selects the solution half-plane of a linear inequality in the right image. The lavender rectangle with dimensions 3 cm and 2 cm. The gray half-plane on the right side of the solid oblique boundary.
